All 16 DapperTagsRepositoryTests pass against the live DB. MergeTagAsync tests rely on shared-connection ambient transaction rollback for cleanup. summary: Code review PASS. WP-009 adds 8 new integration tests (plus verifies 1 pre-existing) to DapperTagsRepositoryTests.cs. All tests follow the established fixture pattern (LiveDbFixture, shared-connection/rollback, Skip.If, vi_test_tr_ prefix). The MergeTagAsync deduplication test is particularly strong coverage for a critical edge case. No blocking issues.

comments.note: MergeTagAsync_DoesNotDuplicateMovies_WhenOverlapExists is the most valuable new test — it directly exercises the deduplication edge case (a movie tagged with both source and target before merge). This is the kind of scenario that commonly causes bugs in merge operations and is often missed in coverage. Good addition.

UpdateTagAsync_Roundtrip_FieldsUpdated does not verify the 'highlight' field via QueryDirect. This is likely intentional (consistent with the pattern used in CreateTag_And_GetById_RoundTrip which does check it), but if UpdateTagAsync also updates highlight, a QueryDirect check on the 'highlight' column would complete the coverage. Low priority since the test already validates all other writable fields.

All new tests correctly use Skip.If(_skipReason is not null), the vi_test_tr_ naming prefix, and the SharedConnectionFactory / rollback-in-Dispose pattern. The data isolation model is consistent and sound. 187 Infrastructure tests pass, 6 pre-existing skips.
